title: Canonical Ramsey theorem for graphs with clean intersections
summary: Extending earlier results of Nešetřil and Rödl [Selective graphs and hypergraphs, Ann. Discrete Math. 3 (1978), 181--189], we show that for every ordered graph $F$ there exist an ordered graph $H$ and a system $\mathscr{H}_F$ of induced copies of $F$ such that every colouring of the edges of $H$ yields a canonically coloured copy of $F$ from $\mathscr{H}_F$ and any two copies from $\mathscr{H}_F$ intersect either in a vertex or an edge or not at all.
